# OMP005 `serialisation-in-innermost-loop`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

An OpenMP `critical` or `atomic` is inside the innermost loop of a parallel loop.

## Why

`critical` lets one thread at a time through, `atomic` serialises the threads that update the same
location: inside the innermost loop they run once per iteration and the parallel loop runs at the
speed of its serial part, or slower. Accumulate in a private variable (or a `reduction` clause) and
combine once per thread, outside the loop.

## Reported

```fortran
!$omp parallel do
do i = 1, n
  !$omp critical
  total = total + w(i)
  !$omp end critical
end do
```

## Preferred

```fortran
!$omp parallel do reduction(+:total)
do i = 1, n
  total = total + w(i)
end do
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[OMP005] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = OMP005` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/cookbook/analysis#choose-the-rules).
